name: zopt_camera_section_set_active_camera
description: zOpt::CameraSection_SetActiveCamera stores the active camera, recomputes horizontal FOV from the render aspect ratio, and reapplies current object LOD.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera option helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zOpt/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408480 validates storing the camera at camera-section offset 8, returning immediately for null, reading render-section width/height, preserving vertical FOV, recomputing horizontal FOV as renderWidth * verticalFov / renderHeight, and reapplying SetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode(GetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode()).
The native smoke verifies active camera storage, aspect-ratio FOV recomputation, normalized camera FOV fields, object-LOD clip-distance side effect, and null-camera clearing.
